statement.notes: 1. All values extracted from the primary consolidated income statement on page 471. 2. Scale is millions (€ million). 3. For total_operating_cost: Includes Cost of sales, Distribution expenses, Administrative expenses, and Other operating expenses. Other operating income is not included as it is a separate positive component. 4. For taxes: The 'Income tax income/expense' line is used. According to the supplementary table (Note 10), this is the sum of Current tax expense (5,858) and Deferred tax income (-1,447), resulting in 4,411 for 2024. The sign convention is followed: tax expense reduces income, so it is reported as a positive number. 5. For interest_expenses: The 'Interest expenses' line is used directly. The sign convention is followed: interest expense reduces income, so it is reported as a positive number. 6. Other operating income, Share of the result of equity-accounted investments, Interest income, and Other financial result are components of operating and financial results but are not part of the requested normalized fields (total_revenue, total_operating_cost, net_income, taxes, interest_expenses).
